notes: SKY replaced MKR via a 1:24,000 conversion ratio starting Sep 2024.
Net MKR Migration tracks all supply mints minus burns, excluding incentive mints.
Sky Incentives tracks farming reward distributions separately.

Net MKR Migration.methodology: Tracks net SKY token supply changes: mints (Transfer from zero address) minus burns (Transfer to zero address), excluding mints to the incentives contract which are tracked separately. Includes MKR-to-SKY converter pre-mints, governance allocations, DEX liquidity, treasury distributions, and supply destruction from reverse conversions and smart burn engine.

net-mkr-migration.name: Net MKR Migration
net-mkr-migration.methodology: Net daily SKY supply change from mints and burns on the SKY token contract, excluding incentive mints. SKY replaced MKR via a 1:24,000 conversion ratio starting Sep 2024.

Sky Incentives.methodology: Tracks SKY farming rewards distributed through the Sky Incentives contract.

farming-rewards.name: Farming Rewards
farming-rewards.methodology: Tracks RewardPaid events from the Sky Incentives contract, representing SKY distributed to liquidity providers and stakers.
